topics.explanation: The chapter defines BODMAS as Bracket, Of, Division, Multiplication, Addition and Subtraction. Brackets are handled first in the order ( ), { }, [ ], followed by the remaining operations in that sequence.
The modulus of a positive real number is the number itself; for a negative real number, its negative is taken, giving a non-negative result.
When an expression contains a vinculum (bar), simplify the expression under the bar before applying the BODMAS rule.
The book lists identities for squares, difference of squares, cubes and sums/differences of cubes, (a+b+c)², and a³+b³+c³−3abc. These are used as shortcuts when simplifying expressions.
For two sets A and B, the chapter gives relationships among A−B, B−A, A∩B and A∪B, including n(A∪B)=n(A)+n(B)−n(A∩B).
